:::{#thm-conditional-entropy-average}
#### Conditional entropy as an average of entropies given a value

For $X$ and $Y$ as in @def-joint-entropy,

$$H(Y \mid X) = \sum_{x} p(x) \, H(Y \mid X=x),$$

where $p(x) \eqdef \P(X=x)$ and the sum runs over the values $x$ with $p(x) > 0$.

:::

::: {.proof}

The [law of iterated expectations](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#thm-lie)
conditions on $X$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
H(Y \mid X)
&= \E{-\log p(Y \mid X)} \\
&= \E{\condE{-\log p(Y \mid X)}{X}} \\
&= \sum_{x} p(x) \, \condE{-\log p(Y \mid x)}{X=x} \\
&= \sum_{x} p(x) \, H(Y \mid X=x).
\end{aligned}
$$

The third line is the definition of expectation over the values $x$ of $X$,
and the last line is @def-entropy-given-value.

:::
